candidate.title: scTrio-Seq2
candidate.scope: Schematic-level architecture of the middle row labeled scTrio-Seq2 / Single-cell triple omics sequencing version 2. It depicts separation of one cell into RNA-containing supernatant and a nuclear fraction, an RNA-to-cDNA sequencing route, an upper DNA adapter/sequencing route associated with copy number alterations, and a lower bisulfite/random-priming DNA route inside the scBS-Seq component. scBS-Seq is an embedded subprotocol, not an additional target method. The neighboring scTrio-Seq row above and partial scNMT-seq row below are separate contextual rows and are excluded. The graph preserves the drawn branches without claiming that the abstract-only primary evidence verifies this exact implementation.

method_scopes.rationale: All operations belong specifically to the middle row labeled scTrio-Seq2 and its connected gray scBS-Seq component. The three left-side analyte icons are readout descriptions, not an additional workflow. Repeated PCR/sequence captions are separate branch-specific instances. Applicability is resolved for this assigned schematic; complete agreement with the primary implementation is not established by the supplied abstract. No operation from the neighboring scTrio-Seq or scNMT-seq rows is assigned to this method.

unknowns.question: Does the Bian scTrio-Seq2 implementation construct an independent unconverted DNA library as the upper nuclear branch shows, or obtain copy-number information from the bisulfite library? The supplied abstract does not resolve this. Primary methods and the corresponding library/readout description are needed before identifying the drawn three-route architecture with an exact experimental implementation. The graph preserves the separate route actually drawn.

What does UMI mean in the final scBS-Seq caption, and where/how is such an identifier introduced into these fragments? No UMI construction or sequence is shown. Primary methods or an authoritative caption for this exact component are needed to establish a molecular identifier, deduplication mechanism or per-molecule grouping; the literal depicted endpoint remains extractable.

checks.rationale: The candidate faithfully extracts the assigned middle scTrio-Seq2 row: single-cell isolation and RNA/nucleus separation, the RNA-to-cDNA route, the separately drawn unconverted DNA/adaptor route, and the lower scBS-Seq route including its return loop and terminal endpoint. All depicted transformations are represented. The three PCR instances have branch-specific inputs and outputs; independent fractions are not collapsed into a joint PCR operation. The shared nuclear source preserves the drawn fan-out without invented aliquoting, and the readouts retain same-cell provenance without invented cell barcodes or pooling. Bibliographic association is resolved separately from abstract-only scientific evidence. No exact-primary-implementation or validated-UMI claim is asserted, so no consequential unsupported correction remains within the declared schematic scope. This review is bound to the inspected candidate using the canonical JSON fingerprint required by the validator, which matches the fingerprint supplied in the caller context.
